summary: Tested advanced admin panel features for DataVision: Dashboard charts, notifications, analytics, and audit logs. All 20 backend API tests passed. Frontend shows 4 interactive Recharts charts (Revenue Trend area chart, User Growth line chart, User Distribution pie chart, Revenue by Product bar chart). Notification panel works with expected 'Disconnected' WebSocket status in browser (SSL/proxy limitation).

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All chart and notification UI tests passed

seed_data_creation: None - tests use existing admin credentials
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dashboard charts and notifications are fully functional. Backend APIs all return correct data structures. WebSocket notifications show 'Disconnected' in browser due to SSL/proxy but API endpoints work correctly.

dashboard_charts_api.details: Returns revenue, users, products data with period parameter (7, 14, 30 days)

analytics_overview_api.details: Returns users, experts, jobs, leads statistics with conversion rates

audit_logs_api.details: Returns audit log entries with filters (action_type, admin_email, limit)

notifications_status_api.details: Returns active_connections count and connected_admins list

revenue_trend_chart_ui.details: Area chart with FieldForce, Survey360, DataPulse daily revenue

user_growth_chart_ui.details: Line chart showing cumulative users by product

user_distribution_chart_ui.details: Pie/donut chart showing user distribution across products

revenue_by_product_chart_ui.details: Horizontal bar chart showing MTD revenue by product

notification_bell_ui.details: Bell icon with data-testid='notification-bell', opens notification panel

notification_panel_ui.details: Shows connection status (Disconnected due to WSS proxy), has Reconnect button

mocked_apis./api/admin/dashboard/charts: Uses generated sample data - revenue/user growth figures are simulated
mocked_apis./api/admin/dashboard/stats: Revenue and growth percentages are simulated mock data

websocket_notes: WebSocket endpoint /ws/notifications works when tested directly but shows 'Disconnected' in browser due to SSL/proxy configuration. This is expected behavior as noted in requirements.
